ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a transition-state structure, with a six-membered carbon ring below; the top carbon of the ring is connected to two oxygen-related atoms above. The left oxygen is connected to R3Si, and is also connected to the right oxygen; the right oxygen is marked with a positive charge and is connected to an H. There are also curved arrows in the figure, but the question asks to ignore the arrows and exclude bonds involving hydrogen. Then reason and count: Count heavy-atom bonds by component. There are 6 C–C bonds in the six-membered ring. The R3Si part counts as 3 Si–R bonds. There are also 1 Si–O bond, 1 O–O bond, 1 bond from the left O to the top carbon of the ring, and 1 bond from the right oxonium O to the top carbon of the ring. The right O–H bond is not counted, and the curved arrows are not counted. Therefore the total is 6 + 3 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 = 13.

raw_record.question_text: In the transition-state structure shown in the image, calculate the total number of bonds in the structure, including single, double, and triple bonds but excluding those involving hydrogen. Disregard arrows and consider all components present in the transition-state structure shown in the image.

method.method_draft: Count bonds by component. First count the six C–C bonds in the cyclohexane ring. Then count the substituent/transition-state heavy-atom bonds above the ring: three Si–R bonds from R3Si, one Si–O bond, one O–O bond, one bond from the left oxygen to the top ring carbon, and one bond from the right oxonium oxygen to the top ring carbon. Do not count the O–H bond or any curved arrows. Sum: 6 + 3 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 = 13.

planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use chemical drawing conventions: each line between heavy atoms is one bond; the label R3Si contributes three Si–R bonds; curved arrows and charge symbols are not bonds; the O–H bond is excluded because the question excludes hydrogen-involving bonds.

method.method_draft: Form the heavy-atom adjacency list from the image. Heavy-atom edges are: Si–R1, Si–R2, Si–R3, Si–O_left, O_left–O_right, O_left–C_top, O_right–C_top, plus the six C–C edges of the cyclohexane ring.
